title: Parts Lead Days in the Repair Plan — Insurance Claim Repairs Parts Department Standard
content:
Parts days in the planned repair days of an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order follow the parts the repair will use, as the repair order's signed consents show.

1. A signed customer-pay addition consent for an **original-equipment part upgrade** adds the part-upgrade days: **2 days**.
2. A signed **non-original parts disclosure** with no signed part upgrade adds the alternate-parts days: **1 day**.
3. A repair order with neither adds nothing.

## Consent combinations

| Signed part-upgrade consent | Signed non-original parts disclosure | Parts days |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 2 |
| yes | no | 2 |
| no | yes | 1 |
| no | no | none |

A part upgrade governs whenever one is signed: the 1 alternate-parts day applies only where no part upgrade is signed, and the two are never added together.

## Hypothetical repair orders

- A signed non-original parts disclosure and no signed part-upgrade consent: 1 day.
- A signed part-upgrade consent and a signed non-original parts disclosure: 2 days.
- No disclosure and no upgrade consent signed: no parts days.
